title: Customer Tenure Pricing for Small Business Electricity Supply Renewals
content:
Long-standing sites renew at a lower rate. On a Small Business Electricity Supply renewal accepted on or before the contract end date, the whole months from the agreement's service start date to the handling date are counted; 60 months or more take 0.12 cents per kWh off the renewal rate; 24 to 59 months take 0.06 cents off; under 24 months take nothing off.

**From which date is tenure counted?**
From the service start date on the agreement record, the date supply under this agreement began; earlier supply to the business under another agreement is not part of the count.

**How are whole months counted?**
By calendar month, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached. With a hypothetical service start of 15 March 2021, the handling date 14 March 2026 gives 59 whole months and 15 March 2026 gives 60.

**What does each length of tenure take off?**
60 whole months or more: 0.12 cents per kWh. 24 to 59: 0.06 cents. Under 24: nothing.

**Where are the edges?**
From the same hypothetical start, 14 March 2023 is 23 whole months and takes nothing off; 15 March 2023 is 24 and takes 0.06 cents off; 14 March 2026 (59) takes 0.06 cents off; 15 March 2026 (60) takes 0.12 cents off.
